channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: McAlister's Deli: $5 Regular Sandwich for McAlister's Rewards Members
item.guid: McAlister's Deli-$5 Regular Sandwich for McAlister's -2026-10-30
item.description: Friday, October 30 through Wednesday, November 3: McAlister's Rewards members (free account) get any regular sandwich for $5, in the app or online with the reward applied at checkout. Reported by USA Today on October 28 from the chain's National Sandwich Day announcement; participating locations. (South, Midwest & Mid-Atlantic only) (Through November 3, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Noodles & Company: $7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7
item.guid: Noodles & Company-$7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7-2026-10-30
item.description: Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page. (Through November 15, 2026)

item.title: Subway: BOGO Free Footlong for Sub Club Members
item.guid: Subway-BOGO Free Footlong for Sub Club Members-2026-10-30
item.description: Buy one footlong, get a second footlong free (equal or lesser value) for Sub Club members ordering via app or online, announced in Subway's own newsroom; free account required. (Through November 8, 2026)

item.title: Safeway: $5 Friday: Fresh Sushi Rolls for $5
item.guid: Safeway-$5 Friday: Fresh Sushi Rolls for $5-2026-10-30
item.description: Every Friday, Safeway's $5 Friday lineup includes fresh sushi rolls from the in-store counter for $5 (regularly $8 to $10), alongside other prepared-food deals like an 8-piece chicken bag. Check the weekly ad for your division; a free Safeway for U account may be needed for the promo price. (Select states only) (Fridays only)

item.title: Harris Teeter: $6 Sushi Friday: California, Vegetable, Spicy Tuna and Spicy Salmon Rolls
item.guid: Harris Teeter-$6 Sushi Friday: California, Vegetable, -2026-10-30
item.description: Every Friday, Harris Teeter's Zenshi sushi counters sell four rolls for $6 each: California, Vegetable, Spicy Tuna and Spicy Salmon (regularly about $9.49 to $10.49). In store, while supplies last; the free VIC card may be needed for the promo price. Seen in store October 2, 2026. (Southeast & Mid-Atlantic only) (Fridays only)

item.title: Taziki's Mediterranean Cafe: Kids Eat Free: Free Kid'Zikis Meal with Each Adult Entree Through Halloween
item.guid: Taziki's Mediterranean Cafe-Kids Eat Free: Free Kid'Zikis Meal w-2026-10-30
item.description: Halloween week through Saturday, October 31: every adult entree comes with a free Kid'Zikis meal (grilled cheese, Child's Feast or Sneaky Taziki, plus a kids drink and a side) for children 12 and under, dine-in only, one per guest, no costume or account needed. Not available online; participating locations, so check yours. Announced by Taziki's on October 26. (19 states (South & Southeast) only) (Through October 31, 2026)

item.title: Moe's Southwest Grill: Halloween BOGO: Buy One Entree, Get One Free (Oct 30 to Nov 1)
item.guid: Moe's Southwest Grill-Halloween BOGO: Buy One Entree, Get One -2026-10-30
item.description: Burritos, bowls, salads, quesadillas and tacos: buy one entree and the second is free, October 30 through November 1 for Moe Rewards members (free account) online or in store; on October 31 anyone can get it in store by mentioning it at checkout. Listed on Moe's own offers page. (35 states (Southeast, Northeast & Midwest) only) (Through November 1, 2026)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bowl, Chicken Burrito or 3 Tacos al Carbon with Chips and a Drink
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bo-2026-10-30
item.description: El Pollo Loco's value combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, 3 Tacos al Carbon) come with chips and a regular drink for $5.99 to $6.99 at a Los Angeles store on order.elpolloloco.com, checked October 3, 2026. The chain advertised them at $5 through 2022; prices vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Hy-Vee: Sushi Friday: Buy One Nori Roll, Get One 50% Off
item.guid: Hy-Vee-Sushi Friday: Buy One Nori Roll, Get One-2026-10-30
item.description: Every Friday at participating Hy-Vee stores, buy one regular Nori Sushi roll and get a second at half price. Store-run promotion: participation varies, no card or app needed. (Midwest only) (Fridays only)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-10-30
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-10-30
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Salata: $2 Second Protein on Any Salad or Wrap with Code STACKED
item.guid: Salata-$2 Second Protein on Any Salad or Wrap w-2026-10-30
item.description: Through Sunday, November 1: double the protein on any salad or wrap for $2 instead of the usual add-on price. Enter code STACKED at salata.com or app checkout, or give it at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; participating locations. The code and dates are on Salata's own homepage. (Texas & South only) (Through November 1, 2026)

item.title: Smoothie King: Free Upsize Friday: 32 oz Smoothie for the Price of a 20 oz
item.guid: Smoothie King-Free Upsize Friday: 32 oz Smoothie for t-2026-10-30
item.description: Every Friday, Healthy Rewards members (free account required) get a 32 oz smoothie for the price of a 20 oz when they order in the Smoothie King app, at participating locations. Rewards cannot be redeemed on these orders. (Fridays only)

item.title: Newk's Eatery: Free Kids Meal with Adult Entree (Halloween Weekend)
item.guid: Newk's Eatery-Free Kids Meal with Adult Entree (Hallow-2026-10-30
item.description: Newk's Rewards members (free account) get a free kids meal with the purchase of an adult entree, announced by Newk's email on October 29 ("THIS WEEKEND ONLY: Get a free kids meal!"), valid through Sunday, November 1. Participating locations. (South only) (Through November 1, 2026)

item.title: Pokeworks: Free Spam Musubi with Any Entree Purchase
item.guid: Pokeworks-Free Spam Musubi with Any Entree Purchas-2026-10-30
item.description: Email-announced freebie for Pokeworks mailing list members (free sign-up) with any entree purchase through Sunday, November 1. Participating locations. (Select states only) (Through November 1, 2026)
